Name: The Beebox
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
6/29/24 [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194002489-bobidibop/]Bobidibop[/url] fixed some kinks[quote]﻿Managed to edit out some of the kins (Though just for the bee boxes and not the tappers so can't confirm if they work or not) They now produce flavored honey at the correct price. However, for personal preference, I also made it so the honey spinner outputs an empty frame as well. As a result, I rebalanced it to only provide 1-3 honey. 
One thing to note, I made it so that the combs are recalculated upon pickup so that, even if the tray is inserted before a flower is fully grown, if it is grown when picked up, you'll get flower comb. This makes it so that the displayed quality on the machine doesn't match the quality of the received item. "[/quote]

Based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16996]Original Mod [/url]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/182393643]SpectrumCollective[/url] who gave me permission to make this version. You can use both versions they do not affect eachother. 

Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111/about-me?gameId=1303]Aimon [/url]﻿as always! For the sprites & craftables. You should comission them [url=https://simonk112.carrd.co/]here[/url]﻿!

This mod probably wouldn't be possible without [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/zombifier/mods]Selph/zombifier[/url] especially with their[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256] Extra Machine Configs[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework[/url]. They really helped me with this mod!

The 5 craftables are Beebox, Stacked Beebox,  Beebox Tapper, Stacked Beebox Tapper & Honey Seperator

[list]
[*]Bee Box- produces1 honey filled frame  in 4 days when you put one empty frame into the box (quality is random). Put neat flowers or fruit tree it produces flavored/colored frame
[/list][list]
[*]Stacked Bee Box - produces 2 honey filled frames in 4 days when you put in two frames. (quality is random). Put neat flowers or fruit tree it produces flavored/colored frame.
[/list][list]
[*]Bee Box Tapper- produces 1 honey filled frame in 4 days when you put one empty frame into the box (quality is random), the tapper is unable to copy flavor so it only produces a Honey Comb Frame both on wild and fruit trees.
[/list][list]
[*]Stacked Bee Box Tapper- produces 2 honey filled frames in 4 days when you put one empty frame into the box (quality is random), the tapper is unable to copy flavor so it only produces a Honey Comb Frame both on wild and fruit trees.
[/list][list]
[*]Honey Seperator - Seperates the honey from the frames ib 10 hours, it will give you honey (random from 2-4) , 1 cut comb. This copies the quality from the frames you put in the seperator, wax and honey will be same quality. You can use the cut comb (2)  to make bee bread (which isn't actual bread lol) in the preserves jar.
[/list]
Should work with all modded flowers/fruit trees. 

Make sure to check out the images to get a better idea of the mod.

You can either unlock all items aft level 3 farming and craft them there or you can buy them from marnie's for a costly price (you can change price in objects.json or any craftables.json file)

You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url] if you want to get fruit flavored honey on trees and you can do other modifying with the mod. 

I [b]HIGHLY[/b] suggest you use Even [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Better Artisan Good Icons[/url] & or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Mead[/url] to get because the sprites may come out weird or you can go into the honeyspinner.json and turn[i] [/i][i]"selph.ExtraMachineConfig.CopyColor"[/i]: [i]"true", [/i]to false you will still get flavor but just regular colored honey.

All items besides honey seperator are configurable are configureable if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]  these items either come in two different versions or seasonal. All beeboxes/tappers you can make them change them to seasonal or keep them plain which is default. There are two versions of the frames you can change it aswell but default is the frames facing forward.
